description: Friday Node protocol v2 grant vectors (Phase 10 brief D2, D5 checks 13-20). TEST VECTORS ONLY: both private keys are public; unpinned_key_id is never pinned. grant.sig = base64url-no-pad(Ed25519(grant_domain + canonical JSON of the grant without sig)); the envelope is then signed in the invoke/v2 domain with the grant embedded. Each refusal is a frame a compromised server could sign; a conforming node refuses it with `code` at `check` given `node_state` (checks 1-12 pass).

node_state.catalogue: the server's own contracts (nodes/capabilities/v1 and v2), all granted
